layout: unit-norm vector in the plain (unrotated) hidden basis

files.refusal_dir_fp32.bin: 5120 little-endian float32, no header; for Swift and C

apply: y -= alpha * dot(y, d) * d, accumulated in float32, on the output of every module that writes the residual stream

alpha.meaning: 1.0 matches a full permanent weight edit; lower trades ablation strength for capability retention; 0 disables

hadamard_handling: none required; the rotation is folded on the input dimension only, while this projection acts on outputs
verified: With all 129 writers wrapped, the residual component along the direction falls to ~1e-6 of the residual norm across depth, measured on the 2-bit pack itself. The packed weights are unchanged, so no quantization error is added.
caveat: The direction was estimated on the bf16 base model this pack was trained from. Architecture and hidden basis are identical, but how well it transfers across the quantization-aware training has not been measured yet. Sweep alpha if the effect is weaker than expected.
